details: Refuted.  On the three-code class, $\mathrm{OSC}=1$ but $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}=2$.  The cited order-compression theorem controls projected recursive teaching dimension for the given class; it does not justify maximizing a separate minimum-teaching quantity over all subclasses.
proof: The three-code class $\{000,011,101\}$ has an order scheme of size one, using the order $000<011<101$.  Yet after omitting, respectively, $x_0,x_1,x_2$, each of its three targets is the middle point of a three-trace path and needs two coordinates to be taught.  Thus $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^{*p}=2>1=\mathrm{OSC}$.
name: Order Sample Compression / Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
